title: Channel Manager

experienceProfile.rawText: 1. Offline channel management for product launch: Understand market/ customer needs, organize to develop overall sales plans, be responsible for the channel operation and life cycle management of various grades of products in the Indian market, and interact with major customers and agents; 2. Project management: As the representative of the channel project, based on the company's product launch process, coordinate various fields of the channel (agent management, customer management, retail, etc.), and promote the implementation of the product launch from the company to the agent; 3. Full life cycle management of products: Through strategic management, maximize product revenue (sales/profits/sales volume), and be responsible for the success of product business (operating results). 1. Proficient in both Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) and English communication is mandatory. 2. Strong familiarity with the cultural and market environment of Taiwan or Southeast Asia (e.g., Malaysia) is highly preferred. 3.Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 4.Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions. 5.Proactive and self-motivated with a strong desire to learn and grow. 1. title: Product Marketing Manager
jobDescription:
1.Marketing Strategy: Assist in the development and implementation of marketing strategies to promote products and enhance brand awareness. 2.Campaign Execution: Work closely with cross-functional teams to execute marketing campaigns, including planning, coordination, and monitoring of campaign performance. 3.Market Research: Conduct market research and competitor analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and challenges in the smartphone industry. 4.Content Development: Collaborate with the content team to create engaging and relevant marketing materials, including social media content, blog posts, and promotional materials. 5.Analytics and Reporting: Analyze marketing data to evaluate the success of campaigns, track key performance indicators, and provide insights for continuous improvement. 6.Brand Management: Contribute to building and maintaining the brand image through consistent messaging and innovative marketing initiatives.
1. Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
2. Proficient in both Chinese (Simplified & Traditional) and English communication is mandatory.
3. Strong familiarity with the cultural and market environment of Taiwan or Southeast Asia (e.g., Malaysia) is highly preferred.
4. Strong passion for technology and a deep understanding of the smartphone market.
5. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
6. Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
7.
